title: Telegram
intro: Bind a Telegram bot to one of your saved agents. A person who messages the bot talks to that agent, in a conversation of their own.
name: Name
tokenHelp: From @BotFather. It is kept sealed and never shown again.
tokenSaved: Saved. Type a new token to replace it.
anyone: Anyone who can message the bot
anyoneWarning: Anyone who can message this bot can use this agent's tools, as you. Each person gets a conversation of their own.
notifyChat: Send my notifications to this chat ID
notifyHelp: Optional. A numeric Telegram chat ID.

confirmDelete.title: Delete {{name}}?
confirmDelete.message: The bot stops answering, and the bot token saved with it is deleted. To set the bot up again you must enter the token again.
